response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, '(missing)') AS mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, '(missing)')), shares AS (SELECT mix, cnt, CAST(cnt AS NUMERIC) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM grouped), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.mix, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_avg_by FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY above_avg_by DESC;
